purpose: Eliminate publication-wait as the primary research work state. When one external dependency is closed, automatically route effort to another legal material lane until all such lanes are genuinely exhausted.
work_conserving_rule: WAITING is not an admissible primary work state. A closed external dependency triggers immediate lane switching. BLOCKED is admissible only after every legal material lane below is exhausted or requires Owner authority.

lanes.work: Positive-navigation readiness, strict whole-Day1 PRE capture, candidate membership, official identity, contemporaneous same-race assignment, provenance, support receipt.
Audit only already-captured pre-cutoff evidence under its original frozen contract; exact-name cross-circumference screening; no post-cutoff repair or reconstruction.

Plan acquisition against the frozen adequacy gate rather than chronological waiting: 30 unique supported riders, 60 supported rows, >=2 venues and >=2 calendar blocks per circumference, concentration limits, identity mapping 1.0.

lanes.jp: 取得・検証ツール強化
lanes.work: Self-tests, negative fixtures, duplicate protection, fail-closed ambiguity handling, resolver readiness, provenance validation and deterministic handoff state.

priority_function: Interrupt all lower lanes when an actual positive Day1 racecard appears before cutoff.
Otherwise choose the legal task with highest expected frozen-gate deficit reduction per external dependency.
Prefer distinct riders, underrepresented circumference venues and calendar blocks; avoid concentration that risks venue>0.60 or rider>0.10.
Candidate count alone is not progress once candidate supply exceeds the 30-rider gate floor; prioritize conversion readiness and coverage diversity.
Do not expand the event queue merely to create activity. Expansion requires a documented gate-coverage deficit that the current queue cannot plausibly satisfy.
